text: By the memory-nonlinearity tradeoff, capacity a reservoir spends on ___ computation is capacity that is no longer available for linear memory.
explanation: The total capacity budget (<= N) is shared between linear memory (degree-1) and nonlinear (degree >= 2) processing. Because the budget is conserved, every unit devoted to nonlinear computation is subtracted from the linear memory capacity, which is why a purely linear reservoir maximizes MC.
